_comment: The one truth for the A3 system's OSC vocabulary, ports, IPs and network.
Decided on 2026-09-30: every program reads this file (a3_osc.py for Python),
or is rendered from it at install, and nothing else carries these facts.
The register (a3-core tools/tests) fails on any address, port or IP literal
found outside it. Change a fact here and every device follows.
network: what the a3-core package configures (systemd-networkd).
listeners: who listens where -- program, role, host, port.
routes: who sends to which listener. carries: vu marks the meters going to a
port that is not a vu listener (the mixer takes them on its OSC port).
args: the type on the wire. Core announces switches and lamps as floats (0.0/1.0) and
reads every value with float(), so the mixer's values, sent as text, count too. f|s:
the filter mode arrives as a name from the desk (high_pass) and a number from Motion.
relayed_to: Core passes an arrival on to these, the sender left out.
announced_to: Core says it itself, to everybody, the sender too -- a lamp
is status, so the desk's lamp follows the desk's own key.
external: vocabularies we speak but do not own (REAPER, the IEM plug-ins).

channel.aux-send.meaning: send to the FX bus (the beat-synced DualDelay)

channel.cue.meaning: cue the channel to the headphones (its pre-fader send to enc_phones); was pfl until 2026-10-01

channel.filter.meaning: this channel through the master filter

channel.filter.frequency.meaning: the channel's own filter cutoff (was pot_1)

channel.filter.q.meaning: the channel's own filter Q (was pot_2)

channel.3d.meaning: blend between the channel's moving and steady encoders

channel.stem.turn.meaning: the channel's encoder turned by this many clicks (signed): moves its selector's cursor over the nine positions (eight stems, then the STEM toggle) in a ring: left from the first stem is the toggle, right from the toggle the first stem; switches nothing

channel.stem.meaning: the stems on this channel's bus as a bit mask of pairs 1-8 (bit 0 = pair 1 = deck A stem 1); 0 = the analog input

channel.stem.push.meaning: the channel's encoder pushed: on a stem, it becomes the channel's only input and its last stem -- a stem playing on another channel or on the return moves here; on the stem that already plays here, it leaves the channel as the STEM toggle's off does (in stem mode it goes to the return); on the STEM toggle, while a stem plays every stem leaves the channel so the analog input plays, and that stem is remembered; while none plays the last stem comes back as if pushed on its own position (none remembered: nothing happens); without StemDeck nothing switches

channel.stem.cursor.meaning: the channel's selector cursor: 0-3 deck 1's stems 1-4, 4-7 deck 2's stems 1-4, 8 = the STEM toggle

filter.led.meaning: the filter section's lamp: blue HPF, green LPF (was /fx/led)

master.aux-return.meaning: the aux return, the fifth stereo input (was /master/return)

aux-return.stem.turn.meaning: the aux return's encoder turned by this many clicks (signed): moves its cursor between analog (0) and stem (1)

aux-return.stem.push.meaning: the aux return's encoder pushed: switches the return to the mode under the cursor

aux-return.stem.meaning: the aux return's cursor (0 = analog, 1 = stem), then pairs 1-8: 1 = on the return (AUX)

aux-return.stem.mode.meaning: the aux return's mode: 1 = stem (every stem on no channel plays on the return), 0 = analog (no stem on the return)

stemdeck.bus.meaning: set one bus switch of a stem, 1 on 0 off; bus 1-4 the desk channels, 5 AUX, 6 CUE

stemdeck.buses.meaning: a stem's bus switches as a bit mask (bit 0 = bus 1), after every change and for all 8 stems after /stemdeck/recall

stemdeck.recall.meaning: report every stem's buses once; Core asks when StemDeck's hello is news

device.hello.meaning: a device names itself and the sha256 of its copy of this file; Core's window shows whether it is Core's own

core.here.meaning: Core, every 2 s by broadcast: the URL of the joined truth and its fingerprint (sha256 of the canonical JSON)

state.recall.meaning: say the state again; the answer is the ordinary messages

beat.meaning: beat in bar, bar, tempo -- the clock (Motion sends it only in clock mode 0)

vu.meaning: peak, rms (linear) of VU channel n = REAPER out 30 + n for 1-40; 41-48 StemDeck's stems, one each (stem_a1 ... stem_b4: peak of the louder side, rms over both, after knob and mute); 49-50 StemDeck's AUX bus, L and R: peak and rms of each side after the bus; see vu_meters
